To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the WTP for a reduction in odour emissions from a selection and compost plant is 1, 3 and 3, 5 euros per day for a reduction of 10, 25 and 50% respectively.

1) the average WTP of residents to reduce the odour emissions of the plant is 1,500 euro per year; 2) the average WTA of the farmers to accept the odour emissions is 3,300 euro per year; and 3) the average WTS of the farmers is 1,000 euro per year.
the estimated WTP for odour reduction in the case study of Le Cortine selection and composting facility is €1.3 per tonne of waste.

the following issues: the estimation of the odour damage produced by the composting plant; the estimation of the WTP to improve air quality and reduce odour; the analysis of the factors that influence the WTP.

the results show the importance of the odour nuisance and the willingness to pay to avoid it.
